n1.speaker: player
n1.text: (A caseworker with a clipboard and zero patience for unregistered tenants shows up at your door.)

n2.speaker: dana
n2.text: This building is housing undocumented Gatekin. You have thirty days to file, or I shut it down.

n3.speaker: player
n3.text: (She keeps coming back long after the paperwork's filed.)
